reviewed_by: Gemini Pro blind reviewer, batch Re-Harden (mat_g1_na_q1_0), 2026-08-18

competency_fulfillment.rationale:
The items directly fulfill the MATATAG learning competency 'Count up to 100 (includes counting up or down from a given number and identifying a number that is 1 more or 1 less than a given number)'. The samples test counting up from a given starting point (e.g., 'What number comes next when counting: 30, 31, 32, 33, ___?'), counting down/backward (e.g., 'What number comes next when counting backward: 26, 25, 24, 23, ___?'), contextual/verbal forward counting (e.g., 'Moses is counting forward by 1 starting from 16. The count is: 16, 17, 18, 19. What is the next number Moses should say?'), and object enumeration up to 100 (e.g., '(Large group of 73 drinks) — There are 73 drinks.
Count the drinks.
How many drinks are there in all?').

comprehensive_coverage.rationale: The sample set comprehensively covers the required sub-skills across the 1-100 range. It includes early sequence progression in the teens ('What comes next: 12, 13, 14, 15, ___'), twenties ('What number comes next when counting: 23, 24, 25, 26, ___?'), thirties ('What number comes next when counting: 30, 31, 32, 33, ___?'), higher double-digits ('What number comes next when counting: 74, 75, 76, 77, ___?'), and numbers entering the nineties ('What comes next: 91, 92, 93, 94, ___'). Both forward and backward progressions are represented.

cognitive_capacity.rationale: The difficulty and reading load are highly appropriate for Grade 1 Quarter 1 students. Prompts are brief and accessible (e.g., 'What comes next: 12, 13, 14, 15, ___' and 'What number is marked?'). Word problems use simple single-step sentence structures and clear context without extraneous cognitive overhead (e.g., 'Moses is counting forward by 1 starting from 16. The count is: 16, 17, 18, 19. What is the next number Moses should say?').

variant_comprehensiveness.rationale: The packet exercises multiple formatters and question presentations: multiple-choice sequence completion ('What number comes next when counting: 11, 12, 13, 14, ___?'), cloze fill-in-the-blank ('What comes next: 91, 92, 93, 94, ___'), visual/marked position identification ('What number is marked?'), backward count sequence ('What number comes next when counting backward: 26, 25, 24, 23, ___?'), and applied word-problem scenarios ('Moses is counting forward by 1 starting from 16. The count is: 16, 17, 18, 19. What is the next number Moses should say?').

competency_alignment.rationale: Every sample aligns strictly with the target competency. No out-of-scope concepts (such as formal arithmetic addition/subtraction sentences or skip counting beyond standard counting) are present. All questions target core counting skills such as sequence continuation ('What number comes next when counting: 18, 19, 20, 21, ___?') and counting backward ('What number comes next when counting backward: 26, 25, 24, 23, ___?').

scale_appropriateness.rationale:
Numbers evaluated are strictly within the bound of 1 to 100 as prescribed by the curriculum. Items span low ranges ('What number comes next when counting: 12, 13, 14, 15, ___?'), mid ranges ('What number comes next when counting backward: 26, 25, 24, 23, ___?'), and upper ranges up to 95 ('What comes next: 91, 92, 93, 94, ___') and 73 ('(Large group of 73 drinks) — There are 73 drinks.
Count the drinks.
How many drinks are there in all?').
